title: Action Receipts
user: Teams letting agents, scripts, or CI automations change repositories and services who need a readable, tamper-evident answer to what ran, with which inputs, and under whose authorization.
smallest_useful_product: A local sidecar/CLI protocol that accepts declared tool events, chains hashes, signs an exportable JSON/HTML receipt, and verifies it offline.
success_measure: Reviewers can verify scope and command/artifact provenance for 95% of automated repository changes without opening raw logs.
constraints: Configurable redaction and retention are mandatory. Signatures prove bundle integrity, not correctness or user intent.
